Hadhrat Umar (RA) Weeps in salaah

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Shaddaad bin Al Haad
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Shaddaad bin Al Haad says, "I was standing in one of the last rows during the Fajr salaah and I could hear Hadhrat Umar (RA) cry aloud as he recited Surah Yusuf and reached the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: اِنَّمَاۤ اَشْكُوْا بَثِّيْ وَحُزْنِيْۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ
blocks.text: "I complain of my sorrow and my grief only to Allaah."
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) says, "When performing salaah behind Hadhrat Umar (RA), I could hear his weeping from three rows back." [^4]
Devotion and Concentration in Salaah
The Devotion of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) in salaah
Hadhrat Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) says that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) could not be distracted when performing salaah. [^5]

Hadhrat Mujaahid says, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) would stand (still) like a stick in salaah, which was exactly as Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) used to do. That is what devotion in salaah means." [^6]
Hadhrat Mujaahid says, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) would stand (still) like a stick in salaah. It is said that this was due to his devotion in salaah." [^7]

Hadhrat Ibnul Munkadir says, "Had you seen Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) performing salaah, you would surely say that he is a branch of a tree that the wind laps over. In fact, missiles fired from catapults would be falling all about (around him as he performed salaah) but he would pay no attention to them." Another narration from Hadhrat Ataa states that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) performed salaah, he was like a cane fixed in the ground. [^8]
